layout.$description: Window and container geometry. The minimums are the accessibility contract, not a preference: A11Y-15 requires everything stay reachable at 720 × 460, so tab rows and toolbars wrap rather than hiding behind a scroller.

main-min-w.$description: Main window minimum width (A11Y-15). Must match tauri.conf.json.

sidebar-w.$description: Fixed nav rail width on the desktop layout.

content-max-width.$description: Reading measure for settings and detail panes.
